# Vendored Syntyr CSS

Source: https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/v0.3.0-alpha.4

Release: `v0.3.0-alpha.4`

Commit: `fd95f24fef8698637d43fdff0012e5c12a0a2783`

The two stylesheets are verbatim copies of the tagged `dist/` artifacts.
The accompanying LICENSE is MIT. SHA256SUMS records their exact bytes.

Keep these files together. To upgrade, deliberately choose a published tag,
copy both files and its LICENSE, regenerate SHA256SUMS, update this provenance,
and run the site's static and browser regression checks. Do not edit the
vendor files or download them during a normal Hugo build. Put brand-specific
token overrides in `../../main.css`.
